text: dsh-keyboard-shortcut 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的快捷键设置插件。它注册快捷键设置页，供用户查看应用绑定并录制或修改本插件的快捷键。快捷操作包括切换权限模式、调整推理强度、浏览输入历史、展开任务清单，以及在侧栏打开 DeepSeek 状态页。可选设置还能轮换 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 的输入行为。插件偏好保存在本机，不需要 API 密钥。

DSH Keyboard Shortcut adds a Web settings page for reviewing shortcuts and editing its own bindings. Commands cycle permission modes and reasoning effort, navigate input history, toggle tasks, and open DeepSeek status. It can remap Enter keys. No API key is needed; preferences stay local.
我想在一个页面里查看并重新录制 DSH 快捷键。

How can I change the keyboard shortcuts for DSH actions?

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · dsh-keyboard-shortcut：A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with permission-mode
cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, prompt navigation, a status-page shortcut, a
task-list toggle, and an optional composer key remap.

[中文文档](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Overview：`dsh-keyboard-shortcut` adds one page to DSH's Settings panel and eight shortcuts
to the application. The page lists every binding in the running application,
lets you change the ones this plugin owns, and carries a switch for remapping the
composer's Enter keys.

Every shortcut this plugin adds is an ordinary DSH command. It appears in the
shortcut reference, it can be rebound, and it respects the same conflict rules as
the built-in commands.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Requirements：| Requirement | Minimum |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Node.js (for building from source) | `22.12.0` |

This plugin is a **client plugin**: everything it does happens in the browser
half. Its Host half is an empty `apply` that exists only so DSH serves the
browser bundle.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Install：Install into a profile with the DSH plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-keyboard-shortcut
```

Then restart the profile, or toggle the bundle off and on from **Settings →
Plugins** if the profile reloads live.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page：**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts** sits directly after General. It has four
sections:

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · A Keyboard Shortcuts settings page：- **Plugin shortcuts** — the commands this plugin owns, each row editable. Click
  a row, press a combination, and it saves. Press Escape to cancel.
- **Input navigation** — the two page-key shortcuts. These have no command id,
  so they are listed read-only rather than being rebindable; the reason is under
  [Known limitations](#known-limitations).
- **Input optimisation** — the composer key switch described below.
- **Application shortcuts** — every other registered command, read-only. This is
  the table that makes a binding conflict comprehensible: when a combination is
  refused, the row that already owns it is visible right there.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Shortcuts：| Shortcut | Action | Platforms |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> | Cycle to the next permission mode | Desktop Windows, macOS |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd> | Lower the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>2</kbd> | Raise the reasoning effort one level | Desktop |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> | Open the DeepSeek status page in the sidebar browser | Desktop |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> | Expand or collapse the task list | Desktop |
| <kbd>PgUp</kbd> | Go to the previous input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>PgDn</kbd> | Go to the next input | All (fixed) |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> | Open this plugin's settings page | All |

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Shortcuts：<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> is the built-in shortcut reference's
default binding. This plugin claims it through the shortcut preference layer, so
the reference dialog moves off that key and stays reachable from **Settings →
General → Edit shortcuts**. Turning the switch off restores the original
binding.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Input optimisation：When enabled, the composer's three Enter gestures rotate:

| Stroke | Default | With input optimisation |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | Send | Insert a line break |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Complementary Queue/Steer | Send |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Insert a line break | Complementary Queue/Steer |

The switch is off by default.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Configuration：The plugin reads two switches and one binding table from browser storage. Both
switches are off-by-default except the shortcut takeover, and all of it is per
device.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `optimizeComposerKeys` | `false` | Rotate the composer's Enter gestures |
| `takeOverShortcutKey` | `true` | Give <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> to this plugin |
| `bindings` | `{}` | Combinations this plugin delivers itself (see below) |

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Configuration：Preferences live in `localStorage` under `dsh.keyboard-shortcut.v1`, beside the
key bindings DSH itself stores per device. They are not in the Host settings
document, so one machine's choice cannot rewrite another's.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Configuration：Changing a binding through the settings page writes to DSH's own shortcut store —
`localStorage` on Web, `userData/keybindings.json` under Electron — whenever the
registry accepts the combination, so the binding also appears in DSH's shortcut
reference. In the DSH Desktop shell, which the shortcut service classifies as a
browser, a few combinations cannot be stored there; those are kept in
`bindings` and delivered by the plugin instead, and the settings page says so on
the row.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Permissions：The plugin requests no elevated permissions. It reads the session projections
DSH already publishes to the browser and runs the same `/permission` command the
built-in picker runs. It performs no filesystem access and no network requests.

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · Known limitations：- **Cycle, effort, status-page and task-list shortcuts are Desktop-only by
  default.** DSH reserves <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> outside Desktop Windows
  and macOS, and browsers claim <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>8</kbd>
  for tab switching. <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd>
  are not admitted by the browser allowlist at all — a single non-primary
  modifier is refused, and both keys are spoken for. All five commands exist on
  every platform and can be bound by hand; they simply ship unbound where the
  combination cannot work.
- **The DSH Desktop shell is classified as a browser by the shortcut service.**
  It publishes no `html[data-platform]` marker — that marker would make the
  service demand a native keyboard bridge the shell does not provide, and the
  service throws without one — so `desktop:*` defaults never resolve and the
  registry refuses to store the combinations above. The plugin detects the
  window itself and delivers them through `observeFixedInput`, the same raw-input
  path the page keys use. A registry binding always wins, so one press never runs
  an action twic

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · dsh-keyboard-shortcut：为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供「快捷键」设置页，以及权限模式切换、思考强度调节、输入跳转、状态页快捷键、任务清单开关和可选的输入框按键重映射。

[English](README.md)

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 概述：`dsh-keyboard-shortcut` 在 DSH 的设置面板中增加一个页面，并为应用增加八个快捷键。该页面会列出当前运行中的所有按键，允许你修改本插件拥有的按键，并提供一个用于重映射输入框 Enter 键行为的开关。

本插件添加的每个快捷键都是一个普通的 DSH 命令：它会出现在快捷键参考中，可以被重新绑定，并遵守与内置命令相同的冲突规则。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 环境要求：| 项目 | 最低版本 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Node.js（仅从源码构建时需要） | `22.12.0` |

本插件是**客户端插件**：所有功能都发生在浏览器半侧。它的宿主半侧是一个空的 `apply`，存在的唯一目的是让 DSH 提供浏览器包。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 安装：使用 DSH 插件命令安装到指定 profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-keyboard-shortcut
```

然后重启该 profile；如果该 profile 支持热重载，也可以在**设置 → 插件**中把该 bundle 关闭再打开。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 快捷键设置页：**设置 → 快捷键**位于「通用」之后。页面包含四个区域：

- **插件快捷键** —— 本插件拥有的命令，每行都可编辑。点击某一行，按下组合键即可保存；按 Esc 取消。
- **输入跳转** —— 两个翻页键快捷键。它们没有命令 id，因此以只读形式列出，无法改键；原因见[已知限制](#已知限制)。
- **输入优化** —— 下文所述的输入框按键开关。
- **应用快捷键** —— 其他所有已注册命令，只读。这张表让按键冲突变得可解释：当某个组合被拒绝时，已经占用它的那一行就展示在旁边。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 快捷键：| 快捷键 | 操作 | 平台 |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd> | 切换到下一个权限模式 | 桌面版 Windows、macOS |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd> | 降低一档思考强度 | 桌面版 |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>2</kbd> | 提高一档思考强度 | 桌面版 |
| <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> | 在侧边栏浏览器中打开 DeepSeek 服务状态页 | 桌面版 |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> | 展开或收起任务清单 | 桌面版 |
| <kbd>PgUp</kbd> | 跳到上一条输入 | 全部（直接读取） |
| <kbd>PgDn</kbd> | 跳到下一条输入 | 全部（直接读取） |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> | 打开本插件的设置页 | 全部 |
dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 快捷键：<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>/<kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> 是内置快捷键参考的默认绑定。本插件通过快捷键偏好层接管它：参考弹窗不再占用该按键，但仍可从**设置 → 通用 → 编辑快捷键**进入。关闭开关即可恢复原始绑定。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 输入优化：开启后，输入框的三种 Enter 手势会轮换：

| 按键 | 默认行为 | 开启输入优化后 |
|---|---|---|
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> | 发送 | 换行 |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | 互补的 Queue／Steer | 发送 |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | 换行 | 互补的 Queue／Steer |

该开关默认关闭。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 配置：插件从浏览器存储读取两个开关和一张按键表。除快捷键接管外均默认关闭，且均为按设备保存。

| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `optimizeComposerKeys` | `false` | 轮换输入框的 Enter 手势 |
| `takeOverShortcutKey` | `true` | 将 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>/</kbd> 交给本插件 |
| `bindings` | `{}` | 由本插件自己触发的按键（见下文） |

偏好项保存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.keyboard-shortcut.v1` 中，与 DSH 自身按设备保存的按键配置放在一起。它们不在宿主设置文档中，因此一台机器的选择不会改写另一台机器的。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 配置：在设置页修改绑定：只要快捷键注册表接受该组合，就会写入 DSH 自己的快捷键存储（Web 使用 `localStorage`，Electron 使用 `userData/keybindings.json`），因此该绑定也会出现在 DSH 的快捷键参考里。DSH 桌面版被快捷键服务判定为网页，有少数组合无法写进那里；这些组合改存于 `bindings`，由本插件自己触发，设置页会在对应行上注明。
dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 权限：本插件不申请任何提权。它只读取 DSH 已经推送给浏览器的会话投影，并运行与内置选择器相同的 `/permission` 命令。它不进行文件系统访问，也不发起网络请求。

dsh-keyboard-shortcut README · 已知限制：- **模式切换、思考强度、状态页与任务清单快捷键默认仅在桌面版可用。** DSH 在桌面版 Windows 和 macOS 之外保留了 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Q</kbd>，而浏览器会占用 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>1</kbd>…<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>8</kbd> 切换标签页。<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> 与 <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>L</kbd> 根本不在浏览器的放行名单内：单个非主修饰键会被拒绝，而且这两个键都已被占用。这五个命令在所有平台都存在、可手动绑定，只是在无法工作的平台上默认不绑定。
- **DSH 桌面版被快捷键服务判定为网页。** 桌面版不写 `html[data-platform]` 标记——写了会让快捷键服务要求一个它并不提供的原生键盘桥，服务构造函数会直接抛错——于是 `desktop:*` 默认值永远不生效，注册表也拒绝保存上面那些组合。插件自己识别窗口，并通过 `observeFixedInput`（与翻页键相同的原始输入通道）触发这些按键。注册表已有的绑定始终优先，所以一次按键不会触发两次动作；桌面版本身也保留的组合（<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>、<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> 等）绝不会被接管。详见 [docs/shortcuts.md](docs/shortcuts.md)。
- **状态页快捷键复用「页面」，而不是「标签」。** 侧边栏浏览器注册为可多次打开的标签类型，因此通过侧边栏自身的 API 打开总会新建标签。插件改为先查找正在显示 DeepSeek 服务状态页的浏览器标签并显示它，必要时先展开侧边栏。显示其他网址的标签会被保留不动，状态页在它旁边新建；属于其他会话的标签会被忽略，因为侧边栏只会显示当前会话中的标签。
- **任务清单开关点击的是面板标题。** DSH 把展开状态保存在面板组件内部，没有对外句柄，因此该快捷键驱动的是与鼠标点击相同的按钮。没有任务清单的会话不会渲染任何内容，快捷键会如实提示而不是报错。
- **输入跳转驱动的是轮次导航条。** DSH 没有公开「跳转到某一轮」的服务，因此该快捷键触发导航条自身的刻度。一轮以其第一条用户消息为锚点，所以「上一条输入」等同于「上一轮」。
- **翻页键无法注册，因此直接读取原始输入。** DSH 的快捷键注册表会用一份封闭白名单校验每个声明的键码（`Key*`、`Digit*`、`F1`–`F24`，以及一组固定命名键，其中**不含**翻页键），`registerFixed` 会预先规范化绑定并抛出 `Unsupported s
